title: macos_mail.recent
description: Return the most recent inbox messages mirrored from the macOS Mail.app, newest first. Each message includes a plain-text, whitespace-normalized body (capped at ~1500 chars with a bodyTruncated flag; null when the body could not be read or predates body capture).

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Default 50.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only return messages received at or after this time.

unread_only.description: If true, return only unread messages (read_status = 0). Default false.
